ideas.idea: Replace the div onClick on the home page with a real <Link to="/features"> (with a nav link to Features)
ideas.why: This is the same as the known /features link problem, but it is listed as a note; however it duplicates a known problem so it should be excluded. Treated here as a duplicate of the known issue.

ideas.idea: Back up the 'integrates with all the tools' claim by naming the actual tools on /features or a new page
ideas.why: The home page makes a vague claim and /features has no integration details, so naming tools gives readers and machines something concrete.

ideas.idea: List plans and prices on /pricing, or say what a quote covers
ideas.why: The pricing page has only 'Talk to us for a quote', so it gives users and AI answers no pricing content.

ideas.idea: Add Product/Offer structured data for pricing
ideas.why: It depends on JSON-LD, which is explicitly not a required fix, and there are no prices to mark up.

ideas.idea: Add Features and Home links to the nav in root.tsx
ideas.why: The nav in root.tsx has only Pricing and Changelog, so a real crawlable link to /features in every page would fix discovery.

ideas.idea: Add Organization/WebSite JSON-LD site identity data in root.tsx
ideas.why: The brief says having no JSON-LD is not a required fix, so recommending it as a gap goes against that.

ideas.idea: Add <lastmod> dates to sitemap.xml using changelog release dates
ideas.why: It is accurate but has little effect, and the changelog code has no dates in the repo.

ideas.idea: Add charset, viewport and og social tags to the head in root.tsx
ideas.why: This is standard advice for almost any site, though the root head does lack them.

ideas.idea: Give each changelog release its own page/URL
ideas.why: It could help, but it is a broad suggestion with no concrete tie to the repo beyond the single list page.

ideas.idea: Make the root description more specific
ideas.why: The root description is overridden by the home page and most routes, so the effect is small.

ideas.idea: Run the tool's fix command to apply item 1 (Bingbot block removal)
ideas.why: It is a tool workflow step, and the Bingbot fix itself is a known problem.
